companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Benvenuto! Il mercato can wait. A greeting and your name first, please. There is paperwork, even for having manners.
lines.translation: Welcome! The market can wait. A greeting and your name first, please. There is paperwork, even for having manners.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Above it, a half-translated sign appears to have lost an argument with itself.

lines.native: Benvenuto! Il mercato awaits. Your greeting is accepted; your name is still missing. Paperwork does hate a blank.
lines.translation: Welcome! The market awaits. Your greeting is accepted; your name is still missing. Paperwork does hate a blank.
lines.narrative: Portia ticks a box in the visitors’ book lodged in her keystone. The arch remains firmly unwelcoming in the structural sense.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam! Benvenuto. Your introduction is approved. And the archway receiving it remains tragically unasked about. A whole administrative oversight.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam! Welcome. Your introduction is approved. And the archway receiving it remains tragically unasked about. A whole administrative oversight.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her pen hovers over a second column, apparently reserved for reciprocal courtesy.

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! Benvenuto al mercato. You asked. How very proper. Do go through before I become sentimental about the paperwork.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! Welcome to the market. You asked. How very proper. Do go through before I become sentimental about the paperwork.
lines.narrative: The archway’s keystone opens to reveal a visitors’ book. Portia records Sam’s name, then her own, with the flustered precision of a clerk unexpectedly invited to a party.
